reason: B accepts our staff's numbers, then gives us something to act on: a specific alternative (three fish or a shorter season), trip logs and a catch-reporting pilot, and an honest, bounded claim about closures backed by two captains who say they would sell. A gets its own arithmetic wrong (32 trips at $900 is about $29,000, not $27,000), extrapolates one boat's loss across all 11, and offers nothing in return.
